help.title: Commands
help.economy:
`/balance` — check your wallet
`/daily` — daily coins (streaks give a bonus)
`/work` — earn coins every 30 minutes
`/give` — give coins to someone
`/leaderboard` — the richest, or the biggest net losers
help.games:
`/coinflip` — 50/50 against the house
`/coinflip opponent:@user` — challenge a specific member
`/coinflip mode:Open challenge` — anyone on the server can accept
`/rps` — rock, paper, scissors against the bot (same `opponent` and `mode` options)
`/blackjack solo bet` — blackjack alone against the dealer (Hit, Stand, Double, Split, Insurance)
`/blackjack create` — open a table up to 5 players can join
`/slots spin bet` — slot machines: pick Fruit, Classic or Jackpot with `machine`, and up to 5 at once with `spins` (`/slots paytable` shows the payouts)
`/mines bet` — find diamonds on a 4×5 board and cash out before you hit a mine (`mines` sets 2–10 mines, max 25×)
`/roulette bet type` — European roulette: red/black, even/odd, dozens or columns (`number` bets on a single number for 36×)
`/plinko bet` — balls through pegs: `rows` 8/12/16, `risk` low/medium/high (up to 1000×), up to 10 with `balls`
`/poker create` — No-Limit Texas Hold'em for 2–6 players with real side pots
help.settings: `/language` — change the bot's language (requires Manage Server)
help.footer: Everyone starts with {amount}. The coins are fake, the drama is real.
